 Houston weather: Slight rain chances ahead of midweek cold front
 By Angie Rodriguez FOX 26 Houston Weather Published  November 8, 2026 6:33 PM CST Share
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Reddit 
 Published  November 8, 2026 6:33 PM CST Houston weather: Nov 8 evening forecast 
 A few showers are possible between now and early Thursday, and a midweek cold front is expected to drop our temperatures by the end of the week.
 The Brief
 Cooler Sunday and Monday 
 Isolated Showers Continue through Veterans Day 
 Cool Down To End The Week 
 Cooler Sunday, on-and-off-showers
 Sunday temperatures topped in the mid to upper 60s, some spots on the urban island maxed out at 70 degrees. 
 Areas Southwest of Houston could see periods of on and off rain, especially towards Victoria County. The best chance for heavy rain and flooding will be across South Texas, where there is a Level 2 out of 4 risk for street flooding Sunday, decreasing to a 1 out of 4 risk for Monday.
 Showers continue this week
 A few showers are possible on Monday. With thick cloud over, afternoon highs stay in the upper 60s to low 70s. Rain chances drop on Tuesday. 
 A cold front is approaching the region late Wednesday into early Thursday, which means we could see some coastal showers develop midweek. 
 Cool end to the week
 Once our midweek front clears, temperatures will drop to end the week. Highs go from the upper 70s on Wednesday and Thursday, to the low 70s Friday and Saturday. 
 Wake up temps will also be in the 40s and 50s across the Greater Houston area!
